title: Kestrel and the Thorn
author: Hazel Eriksen
blurb: Noor Nakamura, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
